test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

My sister treats me well in the morning but at night she becomes ______.
solution: The correct answer is '**awful**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**awful**'. • **Awful**: very bad or unpleasant. (बहुत बुरा, अत्‍यधिक अरुचिकर) • *Example: We had an **awful** holiday. It rained every day.* • We know that '**But**' is used to connect ideas that contrast. • Here, **two contrasting **situations are discussed. • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.** **Correct Sentence:__** *My sister treats me well in the morning but at night she becomes **awful**.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **eloquent**: able to use language and express your opinions well, especially when you speak in public. (सार्वजनिक प्रसंग में वाणी का प्रयोग करने में दक्ष; वाक्‌चतुर) • **exemplary**: very good; that can be an example to other people. (श्रेष्‍ठ, बहुत अच्‍छा; औरों के लिए आदर्श) • **acceptable**: that can be allowed. (जिसे माना जा सके; स्‍वीकार्य) 3a:Tadf, The correct answer is '**Depressing**'.
